review: Reviewed the release ui-1dffa0701c0a (source cd6b3e87, public ui-source history; Core and Smart are the same ui commit, Smart in distr/smart). One shared Smart runtime per page: lit, smart-base, page language, position and control spacing live in core/js/smart-base.js, which Core fetches the first time a Smart element is queued; a Smart bundle waits for it (SF.runtimeModule) and defines its element when it arrives. loader.js fetches minified bundles and lazy relations. The lessons' attributes, properties, events, slots, nesting, cleanup and assets do not change; a page that assembles its scripts by hand includes core/js/smart-base.js after core.js. The lessons moved into the guide's part 7 pages (structure holds creating and local components, composite holds nesting, lifecycle holds cleanup, templates holds templates and assets). loader.js at ui-0b8e5c559207 fetches an element's script while its relations load; the lessons do not change. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-84c7312396f6; the page language is read from the nearest [lang] past shadow roots, which the language guide states. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-45c15e706fde. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-82fc0ba882ba. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-86580e83da1b. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-a362f55f864c. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-3a39d8661e65. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-7606ca8693c1. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-3a3949fae1b7. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-d5db9dac5458. loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical at ui-c95d35179e84. At ui-ed193b6adfda core gains placeholder shapes (data-sf-skeleton) and the manifest presentation.skeleton, documented in the states chapter; loader.js and smart-base.js are byte-identical. At ui-1dffa0701c0a loader.js changes only how it scans: an attribute change checks the element itself, added children are scanned when added; the lessons (when an element loads, whenDefined, relations) do not change. The field-renderers lesson (SF.fieldRenderers: the four modes, the field descriptor, the host methods, how a page loads the set) is reviewed against src/smart/field-renderers at cd6b3e87; its «Типы свойств» table is generated by scripts/build-property-types-reference.mjs. At ui-d7685ca01ec3 (source 88861c5e) loader.js adds SF.whenFieldRenderers(), which loads the field renderer set once from the Smart base and settles when any bundle publishes it (event sf-field-renderers-ready), and the registry lists only the keys the renderers read: readonly returns the view for every type, placeholder is read by string, text and the record picker, required by date, choice, choices, the record picker and include. The field-renderers lesson uses SF.whenFieldRenderers() instead of a hand-added script and polling; smart-base.js and the other lessons do not change. At ui-945c2ef505cc (source bfd5b805) loader.js runs a queued load on the next frame or after 100 ms, whichever comes first, so a Smart tag created by script in an out-of-view frame is still fetched, and Loader and icon storage go through core/js/page-storage.js, which falls back to memory where storage is denied (a frame sandboxed without allow-same-origin). The lessons do not change. At ui-7cbf3a19a7a7 (source 5d21c8c6) only sf-context-menu changes (a panel with tabs); loader.js, smart-base.js and the field renderers are unchanged and the lessons do not change. At ui-8711cf7df562 (source b09c469d) the core gains the interface-fragment descriptor check, seven page value types and SF.RegionNavigation, documented in the layouts part; loader.js, smart-base.js and the field renderers are byte-identical and the lessons do not change. At ui-376117eac4fe (source 7d6d95c0) smart-base.js reports a component that throws while it draws: the error is still logged, the element gets data-sf-error and emits sf-component-error {phase, message, element} instead of an unhandled rejection;
